## 1ec2e9f43682

**Reproduced public-domain defect.** The declared `texture` axis lists only
`top_left_seeds|varied_seeds`, but `generate` also accepts each internal
`DEGENERATE_TEXTURES` value: `no_walls`, `no_markers`, and
`multiple_markers_per_chamber`. All three calls return normally, and every
returned grid is rejected by the same module's `self_check`. Thus an accepted
public call can emit a lesson outside the documented lawful domain.

The executable reproduction is
`checks/audit/1ec2e9f43682/verify_degenerate_textures.py`; exact grids, validator
errors, and source SHA-256 are retained in
`checks/audit/1ec2e9f43682/reproduction.json`. The run exits 0. Suggested repair:
move malformed fixtures behind a diagnostic-only function (or reject those
texture values in `generate`) and add a closure test requiring every successful
public generation to pass `self_check` and `observe_overrides`. No audit target
source was modified.
